text:
Dana M: Dropping the final launch blog draft + email hero + a press teaser. Need legal quick-pass, CTAs with exact UTMs, HubSpot routing, and a localization plan. Target publish Thu 9am PT.

Dana M: EMAIL SUBJECT SUGGESTION:
```
Redwood Inference: predictable, production LLM inference  webinar + try-it-now
```

Dana M: EMAIL HERO (one line): Built for engineering teams: predictable latency, practical cost controls, and flexible deployment modes.

Primary CTA: Try the API -> https://redwood.com/signup?utm_source=email&utm_campaign=launch_oct2026&utm_medium=email_hero
Secondary CTA: Register Webinar -> https://redwood.com/webinar?utm_source=email&utm_campaign=launch_oct2026&utm_medium=email_webinar
Hidden field suggestion for HubSpot: launch_campaign=oct2026

Dana M: BLOG INTRO DRAFT:
```
Today were launching Redwood Inference: a developer-first inference platform that helps teams run large language models reliably and affordably across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments. The platform pairs a GPU-optimized runtime with workload-aware batching, KV caching, and smart routing, plus model lifecycle tooling and per-route observability. Read on for benchmark highlights, deployment patterns, and how teams can get started.
```

Ethan B: Love the intro. Two asks: 1) swap "affordably" -> "with clearer unit economics" to avoid loose claims, 2) add a boxed bench-methods link in the blog to /bench/methods.

Priya K: Agree with Ethan. Also we need localized CTAs for EU and APAC emails (separate UTM domains). Recommend: utm_region=global / eu / apac and include hubspot hidden field region=EU|APAC where applicable.

Lena V: tagging @legal for quick-pass. Also a reminder: any percentage or comparative claims must be confined to the benchmark section with a clear methodology link.

Marco T: Ops note: HubSpot form "Launch - Trial Oct2026" exists. Workflow created: "Launch Trial Routing Oct2026" -> Queue: launch-oct26-sdr. Webhook for registrants: https://hooks.redwood.com/webinar/oct is live. Hidden field configured: launch_campaign=oct2026.

press-bot: Automated check: press teaser length 102 words  OK. If you need a 50-word embargoed blurb I can trim.

Zoe R: Social/snippets note: need a 240-char hero for LinkedIn and 140-char for X. I'll draft variations once blog copy is locked. Also request a one-line quote from the CTO for hero image.

Dana M: Press teaser (short, ~100w):
```
Redwood Inference launches a production-focused inference platform combining smart batching, KV caching, and unified routing to give engineering teams more consistent latency and clearer unit economics. The platform supports hosted, dedicated, and private deployments and includes rollout controls and per-route observability. Attend our launch webinar for benchmarks and demonstrations.
```

Ethan B: Product OK with wording. For the blogs bench callouts please include dataset types (chat, long-context, and batch traces) and link to /bench/methods.

Priya K: Localization ops: I'll coordinate translation for FR/DE/JA and provide localized CTAs. For EU emails we should switch CTAs to https://eu.redwood.com with utm_region=eu. For APAC use apac.redwood.com. Also advise legal on localized regulatory headers.

Lena V: Legal quick-pass complete: copy approved with conditions. Any numeric performance claims must appear only in the benchmark section along with methodology and reproducible notes. Avoid absolutes in hero/email.

Marco T: Verified HubSpot workflows: form, hidden field, and queue are set. I added an automation to tag registrants with region based on hidden field for SDR segmentation.

Zoe R: I'll prepare social snippets and a short paid creative headline (up to 30 chars) for ads. Suggest: "Predictable LLM inference". Will circulate creative comps for meta image.

Dana M: Final pre-publish checklist Ill lock: blog body (bench section + methods link), meta image (1200x630) with CTO quote, CTAs+UTMs (global/eu/apac), HubSpot form + hidden fields (campaign & region), webhook for registrants, press CSV, localized CTA URLs, and scheduled social copy.

Ethan B: I can confirm the bench callout copy and methods link by EOD.

Priya K: Translation kickoff in motion. Expect localized CTAs + short translations by tomorrow noon PT.

Lena V: Legal will re-check the final blog before publish to confirm no stray numeric claims outside the bench section.

Marco T: All routing validated. Webhook payload includes region and hidden fields for SDR ops.

press-bot: Reminder: embargo rules? If sending to top-tier reporters, wait until assets are locked and embargo time hits publish.

Dana M: Locking publish window: Thu 9am PT. Ill post final assets and ping @channel when theyre live. Thanks everyone! :tada:
